text:
maria: Heads-up — intermittent cross-org cards seen in canary after we enabled affinity header routing. quickinsights shows small flashes of other orgs' cards when rapidly switching orgs.
ryan: steps to repro?
lina: reproduced on canary-2 with 2 browsers; happens if you open orgA then switch to orgB quickly.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: rollout/affinity-header-opt @ canary-2
maria: exact repro I used: 1) toggle new header 'x-affinity-tag' 2) open /quickinsights?org=orgA 3) in same session hit /quickinsights?org=orgB with header still present 4) observe transient cards from orgA rendered in orgB.
ashley: pasted router debug snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:01Z console.router DEBUG matched route quickinsights query_org=orgB header x-aff=orgA cache_key=quickinsights:orgA:panel:42
```
dan: looks like cache key generation used header value even though auth principal is orgB. if header gets stripped later, downstream services read from canonical org and show orgB results but cached payload came from orgA.
kai: my guess: proxy order mismatch. edge injects x-affinity-tag then an internal proxy strips/normalizes headers before cache middleware. cache middleware does conditional keying (if header present then key=header else key=ctx.org) — race window.
maria: minimal curl to repro: 
```
curl -H "x-affinity-tag: orgA" "https://console.internal/quickinsights?org=orgB"
```
pm-jordan: this could cause sensitive rows from orgA to appear in orgB. label P0 and get legal/ops in the loop if prod.
eva-sre: agreed P0; if we see this in prod open incident and consider pausing the rollout.
ryan: short-term fix: force cache key to include server-side canonical org_id (from JWT) and ignore x-affinity-tag for keying. Medium-term: validate header binding against auth principal (reject/normalize mismatches) and make proxies either preserve or reject affinity headers.
lina: I'll file a PR for cache key normalization + unit tests, and add an integration test to e2e that flips headers and asserts no cross-org panels.
dan: add observability: counters console.cache.key_mismatch and console.header.mismatch_detected, and a sampling pipeline that attaches request IDs for any mismatch for faster triage.
maria: action list: lina PR (cache key normalization + tests), ryan runtime patch, kai audit proxy order + config, eva set up alerts on new telemetry. I recommend pausing canary until changes are validated.
ryan: pinging @eng-runtime to confirm any KV-cache dedupe behavior that might cache by first-seen header and leak to others.
maria: will pause the canary and rollback if >5 cross-org-card events in 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary paused: rollout/affinity-header-opt (reason: cross-org-panel-detection)
maria: adding links to repro gist and runbook: https://git.internal/gists/affinity-repro-2 and https://runbooks.internal/console-crossorg; quick sync at :30 to coordinate.
ashley: note — rendering pipeline also uses x-affinity-tag in prioritization step; audit needed there too so UI doesn't accidentally fetch wrong cards earlier.
maria: ok thanks — see you in 30. :thumbsup:
